messages.subject: Okafor ET claim — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

As flagged on the phone, we've been served with an ET1 from Priya Okafor, our former Regional Operations Director (East). It's a whistleblowing dismissal claim — s.103A and s.47B — plus ordinary unfair dismissal and notice pay. Case number 2204417/2025, London Central.

We'd like Whitfield Carter to take conduct. Can you send across an engagement letter and a quick view on next steps? The response is due 24 March.

Thanks,
Daniel

Daniel Pryce
General Counsel
Ashbourne Healthcare Group Limited

messages.subject: RE: Okafor ET claim — instruction
messages.plaintextBody:
Daniel,

Thank you — we'd be glad to act. I attach our engagement letter for signature. Tom Gallagher will run the matter day to day with me supervising.

The immediate priority is the ET3 and grounds of resistance by 24 March. I'll need the redundancy paperwork (selection pool, scoring matrix, consultation notes), the personnel file, and anything documenting how Priya's June/July 2024 concerns were handled — the latter is where the real risk sits given the whistleblowing heads are uncapped.

Can Tom have a call with you and Lorna Keane this week?

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment & Litigation
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0820

Confidential and may be legally privileged.
